title: Ya ghareeb hussaina
body:
assalamun alayk ya ghareeb hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
tha yehi ran my ghazi ka nauha
bedast hokar girta hoo maula
ye dard mujhko marne na dega
takti hai rasta bali sakina
aao madad ko ay ibne zehra
assalamun alayk...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne usko naazon se paala
usne jo khaaya seene pa naiza
jalti zameen par girke pukara
zakhme jigar ko maa se chupana
aao madad ko ay ibne zehra
assalamun alayk...
<<DIVIDER>>
hay hay wo asghar cheh maah waala
ghutno ke bal bhi jo chal na paaya
uska badan jo naize pa dekha
baba ke sar se boli sakina
aao madad ko ay ibne zehra
assalamun alayk...
